That's the right call: when I'm just fixing a mistyped or moved address, I don't want it to go re-fetch and clobber the title I carefully corrected. Only the address and the shown source changed, which is exactly what I meant.

That covers the address half of what I asked. The other piece from last round — being able to delete a bookmark outright when I don't want it anymore — I don't think we've seen yet. Could we handle that one next?
